name: jq.ps
description: Parses process-list rows from standard input into JSON records, sorted by descending CPU usage and then process ID, up to the requested limit.

arguments.literal: if ($limit < 0 or $limit > 256) then error("limit must be between 0 and 256") else split("\n") | map(select(test("\\S")) | (capture("^\\s*(?<pid>[0-9]+)\\s+(?<cpu>[0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)\\s+(?<command>.+?)\\s*$") // error("Unexpected ps row")) | {pid:(.pid|tonumber),cpu:(.cpu|gsub(",";".")|tonumber),command:.command,name:(.command|split("/")|last)} | . + {label:((.pid|tostring)+" "+.name)}) | sort_by([-.cpu,.pid]) | .[:$limit] end
